details.description: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent is xAI's real-time multi-agent research mode built on the Grok 4.20 model: instead of one model answering directly, it orchestrates a team of specialized agents that search the web, analyze data and cross-reference findings, and a designated leader agent then synthesizes a sourced final answer. xAI's own documentation marks this feature as beta, meaning its API interface and behavior may still change. It accepts text and image input over a 1,000,000-token context window and launched alongside the base Grok 4.20 model on March 10, 2026. xAI's docs list this exact model id as one of several aliases -- including grok-4.20-multi-agent and grok-4.20-multi-agent-latest -- for the single underlying model grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309.
advantages: Orchestrates a team of specialized agents that search the web, analyze data and synthesize findings together in real time on a single query, per xAI's Multi-Agent documentation.
Supports two configurable team sizes, 4 agents for quick research or 16 agents for deeper multi-faceted research, per xAI's Multi-Agent documentation.
Can enable built-in web_search, x_search, code_execution and collections_search tools so the server runs the full multi-agent research loop automatically, per xAI's Multi-Agent documentation.
Supports Batch API requests at a 20% discount to standard pricing, per xAI's model page.
disadvantages: xAI marks this multi-agent research feature as beta, meaning its API interface and behavior may still change, per xAI's Multi-Agent documentation.

By default only the leader agent's tool calls and final response are returned; sub-agents' intermediate reasoning and outputs are encrypted unless use_encrypted_content is set, per xAI's Multi-Agent documentation.
Not listed among xAI's currently recommended models on its Models overview page, which now points to the newer Grok 4.7 for chat and code.
use_cases: Deep, multi-step research questions that need information gathered and cross-referenced from multiple sources.
Producing sourced, citation-backed answers to complex research queries.
Agentic research workflows that combine web search, X search, code execution and collection search in one request.
Multi-turn research conversations that preserve sub-agent context across turns via encrypted content.

notes: This id is one of xAI's own listed aliases for the model grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309 (xAI's convention for a '-latest' suffix is that it always points to the newest snapshot of the model). The page served at this exact URL is byte-identical in content to the pages for the other three targets in this batch, confirming they are the same model. The catalog's max_output_tokens (1,000,000) could not be separately confirmed: xAI's docs state only one combined 1,000,000-token 'context window' figure. No maker-published accuracy benchmark specific to this multi-agent mode was found, so evaluations is empty. No supported-language list was found, so languages is empty.
